status: FROZEN before any V3 score exists. Prior results (V1, EVT-V2) are preserved unchanged.
supersedes_none: V1 remains authoritative for gen-v1 worlds; V3 uses the repaired gen-v2 generator and FRESH world seeds
features: price-only genome families TREND (s5a frozen schema/mutation) and D (s6a frozen schema/mutation); no indicator inputs; EVT_AWARE_v1 is evaluated only in the separate EVT-V2 experiment
objective: unchanged: 25th percentile of annualized excess return vs passive18 across training worlds; eligibility: max drawdown <= 8% in every world; tie-breaks as v1 (scoring.py hash frozen)
seeds: world seed = derive_seed(experiment_id, split, family, index); mutation/tournament seeds derive_seed(experiment_id, 'mutate'|'tournament', generation, slot, attempt) (stateless)

worlds.training: 12 (2 per family) designated training bank, reused every batch
worlds.validation: 6 fresh, opened EXACTLY ONCE after the final batch, never used for mutation or tuning
worlds.sealed_test: 6 fresh, opened only if validation passes

batches.schedule: at most one per US trading session, Mon-Fri 2026-10-05..09, start 05:00 ET
batches.overlap: skipped, never concurrent (non-blocking flock on the single state store)
batches.interrupt: SIGTERM -> stop after the current candidate; last completed generation checkpoint stands
batches.resume: generation counter continues across batches (batch k = generations 5k..5k+4)

final_step: after the last batch of the week: nominee (best eligible of the final generation) -> validation once -> sealed only if validation passes; otherwise qualification is reported unavailable/failed
feedback_rule: only TRAINING worlds feed mutation/selection; validation and sealed results are never read by the evolver
execution: as v1: 10 bps slippage, 5 bps commission, 18% gross ceiling, 12% halt, 5% volume participation cap
version_note: V3R: V3 seeds were touched by a local smoke run (training + one validation pass, nothing tuned on it, results discarded); V3R uses fresh seeds, so its validation worlds have never been opened
